GOLDEN_SHOVEL.title: Golden Shovel
GOLDEN_SHOVEL.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Build[/gold] [blue]{Build}[/blue].
GOLDEN_SHOVEL.flavor: The crew never stops digging. The shovel mostly supervises.
DIAMOND_SHOVEL.title: Diamond Shovel
DIAMOND_SHOVEL.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Build[/gold] [blue]{Build}[/blue].
DIAMOND_SHOVEL.flavor: Nobody has ever seen a shovel like it. Nobody.
PERMANENT_STRUCTURE.title: Permanent Structure
PERMANENT_STRUCTURE.description: At the end of combat, keep a quarter of your [gold]Wall[/gold]. Start the next combat with it.
SEA_GLASS.TRUMP.title: Gilded Glass
HARD_HAT.title: Hard Hat
LONG_RED_TIE.title: Long Red Tie
LONG_RED_TIE.flavor: Reaches well past the belt. On purpose.
GOLD_PLATED_BRICKS.title: Gold-Plated Bricks
GOLD_PLATED_BRICKS.description: At the end of combat, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] for each [gold]Section[/gold] of your [gold]Wall[/gold].
RUBBER_STAMP.title: Rubber Stamp
RUBBER_STAMP.flavor: It only has one word on it.
LATE_NIGHT_PHONE.title: Late-Night Phone
LATE_NIGHT_PHONE.description: The first [gold]Tweet[/gold] you play each turn is played twice.
GOLD_PLATED_TOILET.title: Gold-Plated Toilet
GOLD_PLATED_TOILET.description: At the start of your turn, if you have [blue]{Gold}[/blue] or more [gold]Gold[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
GOLD_PLATED_TOILET.flavor: The merchant swears it's never been used.
